fire: Hot gas spins the turbine that drives the generator in the plant.

quiet: Hot coffee filled the mug that she bought in Lisbon.

A small painting that hangs in the hall was sold.
The teacher read the story which the class had chosen.
They visited the cousin that lives near the coast.
The children sang the song which they learned at school.

predictions: Fires weakly on 'that'/'which' after nouns like turbine, pump, motor when the clause states the part's function; quiet on relative clauses after ordinary nouns and on complementizer 'that'.
